acceptedInterpretation: B-360e implements only the accepted plan’s Story 1 baseline: additive schemas, exact lifecycle registry, deterministic measurement sidecar/report, and no-output-drift proof. It intentionally defines but does not instantiate PromptEnvelope and leaves Story 2–7 behavior to their ordered Stories, so the broader all-milestones instruction is preserved without collapsing scopes.
notes: The bounded slice is necessary to attribute later Prompt behavior changes against a frozen baseline.
